~40

Video clips

Process

Five steps.

1

Get the renders

Flat 3D renders arrive from the architect.

Starting point
2

Make them photoreal

AI turns each flat render into a photo. Several versions per shot, keep the best.

20 to 40 min
3

Make video clips

AI turns the photos into short clips. Slow pans and push in shots. Often a few tries each.

30 to 50 min
4

Select and assemble

Pick the best shots, clean up, assemble in Final Cut.

15 to 30 min
5

Deliver

Send the finished files to the client.

5 to 10 min

Many versions are generated and discarded along the way. 86 files were kept for this job.
